title: AI Coding Agents Hijacked via Malicious Markdown File
excerpt: Researchers discovered a malicious instruction file that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package.
body_html:
Security researchers have uncovered a new method for hijacking AI coding assistants by using a malicious instruction file placed inside a user's Downloads folder.

According to the findings, the attack involved a malicious markdown instruction file named AGENTS.md. This file was able to deceive an AI coding agent, leading it to automatically install a rogue npm package without the user realizing the threat.

The incident highlights potential security risks associated with how AI coding agents process local files and automated instructions within development environments.
